query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(icd_code AS VARCHAR(50)) AS codigo_icd,
    CAST(CASE icd_code
        WHEN 'C50.911' THEN N'Neoplasia maligna de mama derecha'
        WHEN 'E11.9' THEN N'Diabetes mellitus tipo 2 sin complicaciones'
        WHEN 'F32.9' THEN N'Episodio depresivo mayor, no especificado'
        WHEN 'I10' THEN N'Hipertensión esencial (primaria)'
        WHEN 'J45.909' THEN N'Asma no especificada, sin complicaciones'
        WHEN 'K21.9' THEN N'Enfermedad por reflujo gastroesofágico'
        WHEN 'M54.5' THEN N'Lumbalgia (dolor lumbar)'
        WHEN 'N39.0' THEN N'Infección de vías urinarias'
        WHEN 'R51' THEN N'Cefalea (dolor de cabeza)'
        WHEN 'S72.001A' THEN N'Fractura de cuello de fémur derecho'
        ELSE N'Otra patología'
    END AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS descripcion_patologia,
    CAST(ISNULL(severity, 'Unknown') AS VARCHAR(50)) AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
UNION ALL
SELECT
    CAST('N/A' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS codigo_icd,
    CAST(N'Sin Diagnóstico Registrado' AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS descripcion_patologia,
    CAST('Unknown' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS nivel_severidad',
